verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents AI generating remediation pull requests. What exists is adjacent: deterministic rule-defined fixes applied locally with `--autofix`, an AI Assistant used for triage and noise reduction, and a homepage line about AI remediation that says nothing about PRs. None of these show AI drafting a reviewable PR for a finding, so there is no direct support.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI draft remediation pull requests for security findings that I review and merge
